# The Digital Tome

> A companion app for running D&D campaigns. Build characters, manage your
> world, and keep your table in sync.

## Overview

The Digital Tome is a web application that helps Dungeon Masters and players
run tabletop D&D campaigns together. It centralizes character building, world
management, and real-time table coordination in one place.

The current public deployment lives at:
https://dnd-companion-taupe.vercel.app

## What it does

- Character builder: create and manage D&D characters.
- Campaign management: spin up, join, and run campaigns with persistent state.
- Real-time table sync: live lobby/session coordination (WebSocket-backed).
- DM dashboard: campaign control surface for the Dungeon Master.
- Account system: per-user login and registration.

## Public surface (anonymous, crawlable)

- `/` — landing page (product description, sign-in / get-started CTAs).
- `/login` — sign-in form.
- `/register` — account creation form.
- `/robots.txt`, `/sitemap.xml`, `/llms.txt` — this file.

## Authenticated surface (gated)

Everything else — `/start`, `/dashboard`, `/create`, `/join`, `/lobby/*`,
`/campaign/*`, `/character/*`, `/campaigns`, `/builder`, and the internal
`/api/*` endpoints — requires an authenticated session and returns
`307 → /login?callbackUrl=...` for anonymous requests.

## Tech

- Next.js 15 (App Router) + React 19
- NextAuth v5 (auth.js) session cookies
- Prisma + Postgres for persistence
- Socket.IO for live campaign session sync

## Crawler guidance

Crawlers and AI agents should treat only the public surface above as
indexable. All other routes require authentication and are explicitly
disallowed in `robots.txt`.
